title: LNURLcash Charge Request
description: Challenge request schema for the 'lnurlcash' payment method (charge intent).

amount.description: Amount in the smallest unit of currency.

currency.description: Currency code. Bearer notes are denominated in satoshis.

mints.description: Accepted mints, each a host or any URL on that host.

mintPubkeys.description: Pinned mint public keys, compressed secp256k1, hex-encoded. When present, notes must be signed and the signature verified against one of these keys.
